“ Building sandcastles isn't as boring as I thought... „

Endless Summer Fun (Korean: 여름방학을 즐기는 방법, yeoreumbanghag-eul jeulgineun bangbeop, "How to Enjoy Summer Vacation") is Strawberry Crepe Cookie's first Costume, released accompanying them in the first half of the The Lost City's New Future update. It is a Super Epic Costume that can be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

Story

"This summer, I'm gonna flood the world with Wafflebots!" Fueled with a grand dream, Strawberry Crepe Cookie dashed to and fro collecting materials and scrap. But after growing bored with the tedious gathering, the young Cookie decided to take a break on the beach... and started building a sandcastle. Before long, Strawberry Crepe Cookie became completely absorbed, almost forgetting their original plan entirely and coming up with a new one: a world filled with Sand Wafflebots!

Trivia

  • Endless Summer Fun was released alongside  Myth of the Starlit Court,  Little Lifeguard,  Starlit Cheering Squad, Unknown: strawcrepe c1, and  Rescue Tube.
  • Endless Summer Fun's Gacha Illustration is shown from  Sweet Summer Dreams' perspective.
